question: Related Questions Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 46259 Country: India Title: Sunnah after witr Question: Can the two rakah sunnah after Isha be prayed after the witr salah? Answer ID: 46259 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1194/917/B=1434) The two rakah salah which is offered after witr is nafl. Yes, you may offer it after witr. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
